description: A small cluster of chunky building blocks sits on the bed in front: a long blue base with a white block and a yellow block attached, plus a green block. Both hands reach forward; the left hand lifts the white block off to the left while the right hand grips the green/blue area, then the left hand places the green block onto the blue base and the right hand removes the yellow block, separating all the pieces and setting them down as four individual blocks.
